subject.title: feat(workboard): bind cards to primary sessions

question: Should Workboard permanently reserve a session key for every non-blocked, non-done card, including cards that have not yet been claimed, rather than allowing conflicts until claim time?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility and operator-policy decision: the branch deliberately makes previously possible duplicate session assignments fail earlier across persisted cards, Gateway callers, and automation.

options.title: Adopt early reservation
options.body: Accept one reserved primary card per session for non-blocked, non-done cards and land the branch after a current-main proof refresh.

options.title: Reserve only active claims
options.body: Keep the prior looser behavior for unclaimed cards and narrow the implementation to running or review cards.

options.title: Define a separate mode
options.body: Preserve existing behavior by default and introduce an explicitly approved strict reservation policy only if the product needs both workflows.

recommendation.title: Adopt early reservation
recommendation.body: Accept one reserved primary card per session for non-blocked, non-done cards and land the branch after a current-main proof refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active implementation and can clarify the intended behavior, though repository-area ownership could not be independently established from available history.
